notes.title: Get MXGP now at the best price ever!
notes.content:
[h1]The Official FIM Motocross World Championship Videogame is now available for 29,99€ / 29,99$ / 19,99£[/h1]

MXGP features all the riders, teams, bikes and rules from the official MXGP 2013 calendar including a redesigned career mode for living the feelings of the Motocross.

The game is now available on Steam at the new price of [b]29,99€ / 29,99$ / 19,99£[/b]
